task.title: Set a bare-metal node to maintenance mode
task.shortdesc: Set a bare-metal node to maintenance mode using the Options menu kebab icon found on each node in the Compute → Nodes list, or using the Actions control of the Node Details screen.

step.cmd: From the Administrator perspective of the web console, click Compute → Nodes.

You can set the node to maintenance from this screen, which makes it easier to perform actions on multiple nodes, or from the Node Details screen, where you can view comprehensive details of the selected node:

ul.li: Click the Options menu kebab icon at the end of the node and select Start Maintenance.
Click the node name to open the Node Details screen and click Actions → Start Maintenance.

step.cmd: Click Start Maintenance in the confirmation window.

info.p: The node is no longer schedulable. If it had virtual machines with the LiveMigration eviction strategy, then it will live migrate them. All other pods and virtual machines on the node are deleted and recreated on another node.

ul.li: Navigate to the Compute → Nodes page and verify that the corresponding node has a status of Under maintenance.
